programmes.d: Not everyone is celebrating country music's biggest night at the CMA awards.
Rayna agrees to film a christmas special at home, but her magazine cover story puts a chill on relationships.
A boy on the high school football team has a crush on Zoe. The town encourages her to wait until after the big game to end it. Olympic gold medalist Mckayla Maroney guest stars.
Zoe and Lemon are having a tough time accepting Lavon and Ruby's (Golden Brooks) new relationship. A talk with George makes Wade see his relationship in a different light.
Despite Zoe's apprehensions, she decides to bid on Wade's basket at the charity picnic auction, but is surprised she is not the only one. Lemon mistakenly wins Lavon's basket.
In order to avoid spending quality time with her mother, who is visiting BlueBell, Zoe potentially ruins Christmas Eve for the whole town.
BlueBell's Pioneer Day is approaching and Zoe and Wade volunteer to help out Lavon by playing the town's "Founding Couple." George gives Brick advice.
George's parents are thrown upon meeting his new girlfriend, Tansy (Mircea Monroe). George's mother devises a plan forcing George and Zoe to address their feelings for one another.
When a flu epidemic heads toward BlueBell, Zoe puts the town on lockdown -- but gets jealous when Wade must stay at his ex-girlfriend's house. Lemon's plans go awry.
George panics when Tansy's (Mircea Monroe) dog goes missing on his watch. Zoe is focused on not losing her good status to a new doctor (Travis Van Winkle -- Transformers).
Wade's excited to compete in the Battle of the Bands contest, but Zoe's suggestion that George play with him backfires. Lemon and Magnolia (Claudia Lee) do some sisterly bonding.
Zoe agrees to be maid of honor for Wanda (Mallory Moye) at her wedding, which entails the difficult job of watching Wanda's mother (Debra Jo Rupp - That '70s Show).
Zoe tries to keep her feelings about Wade under control. Lavon and Wade are forced to work together at the church's casino fundraiser, but when money is missing, Wade is suspected.
Ruby Jeffries (Golden Brooks) helps out when Lavon's plans to make BlueBell a Spring Break spot hit a roadblock. George is jealous to see Zoe with Jonah (Travis Van Winkle).
George and Zoe play Romeo and Juliet. Lemon and Wade are excited about taking over the reins at the Rammer Jammer, but things come to a halt when they lose all the staff.
Zoe tricks Jonah (Travis Van Winkle) into spilling a secret about Brick. Wade and Lemon each try to prove they know what is best for the new Rammer Jammer.
Rose (Mckaley Miller) and Max (Nicholas Podany) play matchmaker for Zoe. Rob Huebel (Childrens Hospital) guest stars as a potential love interest.
In the season finale, Zoe decides to visit New York, but a medical emergency on the plane forces her to complete the trip with an unexpected companion. The band Gloriana performs.
